pixel_description: Photorealistic close-up, eye-level. Top center adult finger pressing down indenting single continuous gray hemispherical dome with fine vertical/concentric ridges visible on flank. Dome sits centered atop thick transparent gel ring bulging outward at rim. Below gel a thinner clear PVDF film disc, below that dark rectangular capacitive grid with dense small squares. Grid sits directly on matte light-gray faceted rigid core with angular facets and dovetail/block base below. From right edge of grid an amber/orange flex tail loops up and over down to green readout PCB with black chips mounted on side ledge/bracket of core. Thick black cable exits PCB to right edge. Stack order top to bottom: finger/SKIN/GEL/PVDF/CAP/CORE; side chain CAP-FLEX-BOARD-CABLE. Critical part SKIN: one element only, domed, elastomeric gray, concentrically/vertically ridged texture, arranged as outer skin covering stack, connected below via gel interlayer and clamped around rim, working geometry dome and ridges visible as in sketch. Scale: dome width about finger pad width, finger-scale, consistent with ~20mm.

regions.observed: Callout reads 'Capacitive Taxel Array 8x8 grid' containing numbers 8x8
regions.expected: Callout naming Capacitive Taxel Array with no numbers

comparison_with_previous: First evaluation, no previous render to compare.

deviations.measured: Apparent gap in exploded view, SKIN above GEL above CORE
deviations.why: Pixels show single gray ridged dome indented by finger sitting inside/upon thick clear gel ring which sits on stack above CORE. Direct SKIN-CORE edge not resolved due to transparent gel and exploded spacing for visibility, but pressure path SKIN->GEL->PVDF->CAP->CORE is continuous and clamp is implied. No functional break; illustration gap does not change working principle.

deviations.measured: Segmenter says apart; pixels show contact/mounting
deviations.expected: CORE to touch SKIN, CAP and BOARD
deviations.why: Pixels show light-gray faceted CORE with flat top directly under dark CAP grid, with CAP seated on it, and right-side boss/ledge carrying green BOARD, and SKIN/GEL stack centered above. Transparent layers cause segmenter to read gaps as separation. Load path CORE supporting CAP and BOARD is visible, so expectation of apart is wrong.

deviations.measured: 1 grid module ~1.4x CORE top, seated on CORE, grid of many taxels visible
deviations.expected: CAP: 10 visible, 0.09x CORE, to touch CORE
deviations.why: Pixels show one rectangular Capacitive Taxel Array module with dense 8x8 grid texture (~64 taxels) as qty 1 per solution (size_class 0.2-2.0mm per taxel, array ~20mm). Expectation of 10 separate pieces at 0.09x misinterprets taxel vs array. Module footprint ~ same as CORE top (~1x) is correct for 20mm fingertip. It sits on CORE; no missing contact.

deviations.measured: PVDF ~1.1x CAP, same footprint thin clear film
deviations.why: Pixels show thin transparent PVDF Vibration Film directly between GEL and CAP with same rectangular footprint as CAP (~1.1x). Per solution PVDF 0.028-20mm film covering array, 1x is correct. Expectation of 10x is wrong; film is not 10x larger.

deviations.measured: BOARD seated on side ledge of CORE, touching via mount
deviations.why: Pixels show green readout PCB mounted on gray lateral bracket of CORE on right side, with amber flex entering it. Segmenter reads shadow/gap as apart, but mounting/bracket contact is visible. Electrical path FLEX->BOARD is continuous.

deviations.measured: Located parts span ~48mm across by 30mm high including board+cable; fingertip dome itself ~ finger-width
deviations.expected: Whole device ~20.0mm by 22.0mm fingertip, largest part 50mm cable, finger-scale
deviations.why: Pixels show adult fingertip pressing dome, dome width ~ fingertip width ~20mm per design, core ~ same. Extended length to right includes on-finger board and message cable, allowed up to 50mm cable and 22mm board. No violation of fingertip size shape 18x28mm finger / 26x20x25mm precedent or 50mm limit. Proportions finger-scale, correct shape domed fingertip.

s1_differences: Same 8 parts in same order and connections as sketch and figure_spec: skin over gel over vibration film over taxel grid on faceted core with flex to board and cable to hand. Slight exploded spacing for visibility but stacking and flex/cable continuity preserved. No missing, duplicated or floating parts affecting mechanism.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed. Faceted core supports grid, flex has dorsal loop with bend clearance, board mounted on core side, cable strain relief visible. Load path finger to dome to gel to films to core plausible, no interference or unreachable part seen.
notes: Photorealistic render, not diagram/CAD. All 8 solution parts present in correct order. Only depiction fault is numbers in one callout.
